brief: The canvas presents a highly detailed and mathematically rigorous display of symmetrical patterns, derived from spirographic mechanics. These patterns fill the entire composition, transforming what would usually be continuous lines into vibrant, interlocking polygonal areas. The color treatment emphasizes the depth and geometric structure, allowing rich, saturated tones to define each discrete shape within the complex arrangement. The piece is purely observational, presenting a complex, non-moving tapestry of form and color.

statement: This sketch presents a meditative exploration of mathematical symmetry through spirographic patterns. Using precise trigonometric formulas, it generates interlocking polygonal forms that fill the canvas in an endlessly evolving yet motionless composition. The work emphasizes color saturation and geometric structure to create depth within a static field of form, where each pattern emerges from simple mathematical relationships—radius, angle, and harmonic frequency—transformed into complex visual tapestries. The viewer encounters a contemplative space of ordered complexity, observing the beauty inherent in mathematical precision without temporal movement.
